objdiff.expanded_command: build/tools/objdiff-cli diff -p . -u main/game/game_fn_8016F678 fn_8016F678 -o build/GEDE01/fndiff_fn_8016F678.json --format json
objdiff.provenance: raw_result is the complete JSON emitted by objdiff-cli; its instruction relocation objects contain relocation type and target symbol index.

elf_relocations.provenance: The symbol names, addends, and ELF r_offset values below come from powerpc-eabi-readelf -Wr on each object, not from objdiff JSON. For split-field ADDR16 relocations, ELF r_offset identifies the relocated halfword (for example 0x3e), while objdiff instruction.address identifies the containing instruction (0x3c).
